name: – Anna Strolenberg – After § 51 – Am 66
title: REPORT on the situation of fundamental rights in the European Union in 2024 and 2025
part_text: 51a. Insists that the Member States have the sovereign right to effectively control their external borders, to refuse asylum and to return persons staying illegally; condemns the instrumentalisation of asylum procedures by smugglers and certain non-governmental organisations;
